detect change early, interpret signals correctly, and evolve the system without panic, denial, or chaos
If the organization is surprised by predictable change, this framework has failed.
Speed of Sense-Making Beats Speed of Reaction
Overreaction Is as Dangerous as Inaction

“This came out of nowhere” is said
